description.en: Analyses a data file to answer a question and writes artifacts/report.md with charts.
description.es: Analiza un archivo de datos para responder una pregunta y escribe artifacts/report.md con gráficos.

nodes.question: Which data file should be analysed? (path relative to {{projectName}}, e.g. data/sales.csv)
What question do you want the analysis to answer?

nodes.text:
Analyse the data file {{dataFile}} to answer this question: {{question}}

Write a clear report to artifacts/report.md (question, method, findings, caveats) and save the supporting charts as image files in artifacts/ referenced from the report. Do not modify the original data file.

nodes.message: Open artifacts/report.md and check the findings. Approve to finish.
